query: Please implement a payment aggregation website that provides multiple payment methods. The website should have functionalities for multi-agent and multi-merchant connection, balance control, and multi-channel polling mode. Users should be able to log in, select different payment methods, view their balance, perform payment operations, and receive payment result callbacks. The website should support high concurrency, fast callbacks, and ensure the security and reliability of the payment process. Style all pages with a khaki background and dark khaki components.
